newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shobunsha bid-only in Tokyo on share split plans.
newsitem.headline: Shobunsha bid-only in Tokyo on share split plans.

text.p: Shares in Shobunsha Publications Co Ltd were bid-only in early Tokyo morning trade on Tuesday, a day after it announced plans for a 1.5-for-1 share split on May 20.
Shobunsha"s shares were bid-only at 6,700 yen, compared with Tuesday"s close of 6,600.

The map and travel book publisher said on Tuesday that it would raise its annual dividend forecast for the year to March 31, 1997, to 15 yen from its previous forecast of 10 yen. It also said that it would pay a five-yen commemorative dividend for 1996/97.
Shobunsha said that it would begin publishing maps of Tokyo containing detailed data of residences and buildings, a line the company expects to become one of its key businesses.
"The planned 1.5-for-1 share split is a big factor (in moving the share price)," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
"Its plan to launch a residential map business is also attracting attention in the market," a trader at a medium-sized securities house said.
